Millionaire Bucks's prizes make it a game built around small prizes that are won often. Of the prize money still unclaimed, most is in wins under $2,000. The prize counts change every day, but this design does not.

Everything above about "Millionaire Bucks" comes from the North Carolina Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
952.headline: The prize mix in this game

959.body:
Most of the tickets for "LOTERIA®" are sold. The top prize count has held, with two of eight still unclaimed. The number of tickets printed is fixed, so that is a plain good sign.

Everything here about "LOTERIA®" comes from official North Carolina lottery numbers, current through November 3.
959.headline: No new top prize claims

972.body:
"$8 Million Money Maker" has had no $8 million top prize claimed since we started watching it. Everyday prizes keep getting claimed, and fewer tickets are left each day. The number of tickets printed is fixed. Each day without a top prize claim leaves those prizes among fewer tickets.

Everything above about "$8 Million Money Maker" comes from the North Carolina Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
972.headline: Good news: no big claims

975.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "$1,000,000 Money Rush", about a quarter are still unsold. The game is well into its run, with two of four top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

Tomorrow's count on "$1,000,000 Money Rush" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
975.headline: How far along this game is

976.body:
Before you buy "100X The Cash", know that its $2 million top prize is gone. The game still pays many smaller prizes, but the biggest one left is $10,000. That is a tiny fraction of the top prize shown on the ticket.

Everything above about "100X The Cash" comes from the North Carolina Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
976.headline: The advertised top prize is gone

980.body:
"20X The Cash" has three of eight top prizes left and is in the second half of its run. About three-quarters of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, a larger share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a good sign.

The numbers for "20X The Cash" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
980.headline: Where this game is in its run

981.body:
